# Perth USAsia Centre

> A research and education hub focused on Indo-Pacific strategy, Australia-US relations, and regional security in the Asia-Pacific.

The Perth USAsia Centre, based at the University of Western Australia, provides policy research, education programs, and events addressing critical geopolitical and economic issues across the Indo-Pacific region. The centre serves researchers, professionals, and students through online courses, publications, and major conferences.

## Key Topics

- Indo-Pacific strategy
- Australia-US relations
- AUKUS partnership
- Energy security
- Trade policy
- Defence collaboration
- Japan-Australia relations
- Indonesia cooperation
- Maritime security
- Knowledge diplomacy
- Geopolitics
- Foreign policy
- ASEAN
- Critical minerals
- Indian Ocean security

## Core Programs & Services

- [Home - Perth USAsia Centre](https://perthusasia.edu.au): Perth USAsia Centre homepage covering Indo-Pacific strategy and Australia-US relations
- [Research & Insights - Perth USAsia Centre](https://perthusasia.edu.au/research-insights): Research and policy analysis on Indo-Pacific strategy and regional challenges
- [Education - Perth USAsia Centre](https://perthusasia.edu.au/education): Education programs including online courses, internships, and professional development
- [Online courses - Perth USAsia Centre](https://perthusasia.edu.au/education/online-courses): Online microcredentials and masterclasses on Indo-Pacific strategy and relations
- [United States](https://perthusasia.edu.au/united-states): US-Australia relations, AUKUS partnership, and Indo-Pacific security

## Research Publications & Analysis

- [50 years after NARA: The evolution and future of the Australia-Japan energy partnership](https://perthusasia.edu.au/research-and-insights/50-years-after-nara-the-evolution-and-future-of-the-australia-japan-energy-partnership): Analysis of Australia-Japan energy partnership evolution and LNG trade
- [The Alternative Sealine - The Southwestern Indian Ocean and Australian Security](https://perthusasia.edu.au/research-and-insights/the-alternative-sealine-the-southwestern-indian-ocean-and-australian-security): Research on maritime security, Red Sea disruption, and Australian trade routes
- [From Export to Engagement: Australia's Knowledge Diplomacy in the Indo-Pacific](https://perthusasia.edu.au/research-and-insights/publications/from-export-to-engagement-australias-knowledge-diplomacy-in-the-indo-pacific): Publication on Australia's soft power and knowledge diplomacy in Indo-Pacific
- [Which sectors offer the greatest opportunities for deeper Australia–Indonesia trade and investment co-operation?](https://perthusasia.edu.au/education/which-sectors-offer-the-greatest-opportunities-for-deeper-australia-indonesia-trade-and-investment-co-operation): Explainer on Australia-Indonesia trade and investment cooperation opportunities
- [An Australia-Canada resource alliance: Why it matters for Western Australia](https://perthusasia.edu.au/research-and-insights/opinion/an-australia-canada-resource-alliance-why-it-matters-for-western-australia): Opinion piece on Australia-Canada critical minerals and resource cooperation

## Events & Conferences

- [Indian Ocean Defence and Security 2026 Conference and Exhibition](https://perthusasia.edu.au/events/upcoming-events/indian-ocean-defence-and-security-2026-conference-and-exhibition): Major 2026 Perth conference on Indian Ocean defence and security
- [Nikkei Asia Forum 2026](https://perthusasia.edu.au/events/nikkei-asia-forum-2026): 2026 Perth business conference on Japan-Australia partnership and investment
- [Roundtable discussion with Melanie Brock AM](https://perthusasia.edu.au/events/roundtable-discussion-with-melanie-brock-am): Roundtable on Japan-Australia relations and defence collaboration
- [Microcredential Information Session for High School Students (Online)](https://perthusasia.edu.au/events/microcredential-information-session-for-high-school-students-online): Information session on Indo-Pacific microcredentials for high school students
- [Microcredential Information Session for Professionals (Online)](https://perthusasia.edu.au/events/microcredential-information-session-for-professionals-online): Professional development information session on Indo-Pacific strategy
